```{r}
# Load human-AI data
df_human_ai <- read_parquet(here("data/human-ai/processed/dyadic_sentiment_scores.parquet")) %>%
  mutate(condition = "human-ai")

# Load human-human data
df_human_human <- read_parquet(here("data/human-human/processed/dyadic_sentiment_scores.parquet")) %>%
  mutate(condition = "human-human")
# Combine datasets
# Note: Column names may differ between conditions
# Human-AI uses: user, ai
# Human-human uses: user, user2
# Normalize to author_1, author_2 for comparison

df_human_ai <- df_human_ai %>%
  rename(
    author_1 = user,
    author_2 = ai,
    author_1_valence = user_sentiment_projection,
    author_2_valence = ai_sentiment_projection,
    author_1_embedding = user_embedding,
    author_2_embedding = ai_embedding
  ) %>%
  select(conversation_id, turn, author_1, author_2, 
         author_1_valence, author_2_valence, author_1_embedding, author_2_embedding, condition)

df_human_human <- df_human_human %>%
  rename(
    author_1 = user,
    author_2 = user2,
    author_1_valence = user_sentiment_projection,
    author_2_valence = user2_sentiment_projection,
    author_1_embedding = user_embedding,
    author_2_embedding = user2_embedding
  ) %>%
  select(conversation_id, turn, author_1, author_2,
         author_1_valence, author_2_valence, author_1_embedding, author_2_embedding, condition)

# Bind datasets
df_combined <- bind_rows(df_human_ai, df_human_human) %>% 
  mutate(
    conversation_id = map_chr(conversation_id, as.character),
    conversation_id = factor(conversation_id)
)
cat("Human-AI stories:", n_distinct(df_human_ai$conversation_id), "\n")
cat("Human-human stories:", n_distinct(df_human_human$conversation_id), "\n")
cat("Total interactions:", nrow(df_combined), "\n")
```

```{r}
df_analysis <- df_combined %>%
  group_by(conversation_id) %>%
  arrange(turn) %>%
  mutate(
    author_1_valence_lag1 = lag(author_1_valence, n = 1),
    author_2_valence_lag1 = lag(author_2_valence, n = 1)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(turn > 1, turn < 10)

cat("Analysis dataset:", nrow(df_analysis), "turns\n")
```

```{r}

cosine_sim <- function(x, y) {
  if (is.null(x) || is.null(y) || any(is.na(x)) || any(is.na(y))) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }
  return(sum(x * y) / (sqrt(sum(x^2)) * sqrt(sum(y^2))))
}

df_analysis <- df_analysis %>%
  group_by(conversation_id) %>%
  arrange(turn, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    author_2_embedding_prev = lag(author_2_embedding)
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    cosine_sim_same = cosine_sim(author_1_embedding, author_2_embedding),
    cosine_sim_prev = cosine_sim(author_1_embedding, author_2_embedding_prev)
  ) %>%
  select(-author_1_embedding, -author_2_embedding, -author_2_embedding_prev) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
df_field_gap <- df_analysis %>%
  mutate(valence_gap = abs(author_1_valence - author_2_valence),
         valence_gap_prev = abs(author_2_valence_lag1 - author_1_valence_lag1))

# df_sim_gap <- df_simulated %>%
#   mutate(valence_gap = abs(user_valence - ai_valence))


df_valence_gap_long <- df_field_gap %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(valence_gap, valence_gap_prev),
    names_to = "lag_type",
    values_to = "valence_gap"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    lag_type = factor(
      lag_type,
      levels = c("valence_gap", "valence_gap_prev"),
      labels = c("Same Turn", "Previous Turn")
    )
  )


# Field data plot
p_gap_field <- ggplot(df_field_gap, aes(x = turn, y = valence_gap, group = conversation_id, fill = condition)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.2, color = "#E41A1C") +  # Individual stories (faint)
  stat_summary(aes(group = 1), fun = mean, geom = "line", 
               color = "#E41A1C", linewidth = 1.5) +  # Aggregate mean (bold)
  stat_summary(aes(group = 1), fun = mean, geom = "point",
               color = "#E41A1C", size = 3) +
  labs(title = "Field Data", x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 18, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12)
  )

print(p_gap_field)
```


```{r}
# Function to compute turn-by-turn rubber-band dynamics
compute_rubberband_turns <- function(df, data_source_label, direction) {
  df %>%
    group_by(conversation_id) %>%
    arrange(turn, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(
      valence_gap = abs(as.numeric(scale(author_1_valence)) - as.numeric(scale({{ direction }}))),
      gap_change = valence_gap - lag(valence_gap),  # Change from previous turn
      gap_change_next = lead(valence_gap) - valence_gap  # Change to next turn
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(gap_change) & !is.na(gap_change_next)) %>%  # Need both values
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      data_source = data_source_label,
      n_turns = n_distinct(conversation_id)
    )
}

rb_turns_combined <- compute_rubberband_turns(df_analysis, "Field", author_2_valence)
rb_turns_field_prev <- compute_rubberband_turns(df_analysis, "Field", author_2_valence_lag1)
```

```{r}
lm_turns_combined <- lm(gap_change_next ~ gap_change + (1 | conversation_id), data = rb_turns_field)
```
